metadata.title: Disclosed UAP Events Batch — August 2026 weekly curation (week 3)
metadata.description: Six additional officially disclosed PURSUE/FBI UAP cases: FBI western slow-moving black-hot pair PR007, CENTCOM Middle East EO/IR PR134, CENTCOM Middle East reticle PR136, CENTCOM Middle East dual-contrast PR024, FBI Bagram triangle D024/D025, and FBI Colorado Springs red-lit triangle D030/D031.
metadata.source_scope: DVIDS/AARO PURSUE Release 05 videos FBI-UAP-PR007 and DOW-UAP-PR134/PR136, Release 04 leftover DOW-UAP-PR024, plus FBI FD-302/renderings D024/D025/D030/D031

events.name: FBI西部慢速黑体（PR007）
events.shortDesc: 2026年3月联邦特工在射频告警后用手持热成像记录两枚同速同向的“黑热”对比体（FBI-UAP-PR007/D032）

events.name: 中东光电红外跟踪UAP（PR134）
events.shortDesc: USCENTCOM提交1分39秒光电/红外视频，传感器跟踪对比区域并多次切换模式与倍率（DOW-UAP-PR134）

events.name: 中东十字线锁定UAP（PR136）
events.shortDesc: USCENTCOM提交约30秒红外视频；传感器跟踪对比区域并短暂套上十字线，期间被平台构件遮挡（DOW-UAP-PR136）

events.name: 中东双亮对比区UAP（PR024）
events.nameEn: Middle East Dual Bright Contrast UAP (PR024)
events.shortDesc: USCENTCOM提交18秒红外视频：两处明亮对比区穿越视场，传感器同时锁定暗对比区（DOW-UAP-PR024）

events.name: 巴格拉姆等边三角UAP（2002）
events.shortDesc: 2002年6月两名美军飞行员目击无声等边三角形；2024年FD-302与FBI复原图于Release 05公开（FBI-UAP-D024/D025）

events.name: 科罗拉多泉红灯三角UAP（2023）
events.shortDesc: 2023年10月两名目击者看到带红灯的黑三角几乎瞬间加速并作90度转弯，通话出现电磁干扰（FBI-UAP-D030/D031）

not_promoted.pr117_siblings: DOW-UAP-PR118–PR122 remain the same Gulf of Oman AC-130 sortie as PR117; kept as related clips, not standalone catalog events.
not_promoted.pacific_2019: DOW-UAP-PR123–PR127 are contemporaneous handheld/secondary captures that AARO says were digitally altered before UAPTF transfer — research-only unless framed as a provenance-caveat case.
not_promoted.pr142: DOW-UAP-PR142 is a 14-second Middle East transit with only ~4 seconds of content.
not_promoted.pr149: DOW-UAP-PR149 is a 51-second generic IR track; deferred in favor of the more distinctive PR024 dual-contrast clip.
not_promoted.fbi_pr005: Artistic digital recreation of a 2023 western US narrative — Speculative if promoted.
not_promoted.bahia_1963: State/EOP/FBIS chain closed a viral Brazilian radio crash claim in eleven days; not an unresolved sensor case.
not_promoted.cia_puerto_rico_1964: CIA-UAP-D022 resolved the contact as an OXCART-program YF-12A.
